description: Search SelfBadge for people with a given name. Use this to identify a person correctly and tell them apart from namesakes: each candidate comes with their job title, organization, location and a short description. Pass what you already know (job title, organization, location) so the best match comes first, then call get_person with the chosen id for the full, verified profile. It returns public SelfBadge profiles, each marked claimed or created from public sources (seeded: level 0, unconfirmed until the person claims it). An empty result means SelfBadge has no public profile with that name, not that the person does not exist.

job_title.description: Optional. What you know of their job title, for example "Managing Partner".

limit.description: Optional. How many candidates to return (default 10).

location.description: Optional. A city or country you associate with them.

name.description: The person's full name, for example "Noa Bergman".

organization.description: Optional. An organization you associate with them, for example "Harbor Ventures".

name: find_person
title: Find a person by name
